caption: The drawing depicts a person standing, wearing a long, full-skirted dress that reaches the ankles. The dress is predominantly light pink and is decorated with a repeating floral pattern in green, blue, and red. It has long sleeves and an elaborate, lacy, white collar extending over the shoulders and upper chest, tied at the neck with a bright red ribbon. The person's left hand is raised to chest height, while the right hand rests by their side. They wear a white bonnet featuring lace and a red bow, with some blond hair showing in curls at the front. The shoes are white and partially visible beneath the hem of the dress. The background is plain, with faint rectangular guidelines and the name "Bertha Semple" written in the bottom right corner.
title: Puppet - "Mrs. Shelby"
